title: Sesame Crusted Tofu with Snap Pea, Cucumber & Cilantro Salad

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger; place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil and salt; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Place sesame seeds and cornstarch in another medium bowl; stir to combine.
Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Spread mayo over both sides of the tofu, then dredge in the sesame coating, pressing gently to adhere. Return to the baking sheet.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the tofu and cook until the coating is golden and tofu is warmed through, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut snap peas crosswise into thin pieces, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide tofu and salad between plates. Enjoy!
